translations.text: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what will happen soon. He made it known by sending it out through his angel and his servant John.
He bore witness to the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ, to the things he saw.
Blessed are those who read and those who hear the words of this prophecy, and those who keep what is written in it, because the time has drawn near.
John writes to the seven churches in Asia: Grace and peace to you from the one who is, who was, and who is coming, and from the seven spirits before his throne,
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, the ruler of the kings of the earth, who loved us and cleansed us from our sins by his blood.
And he made us a kingdom of our God and priests to God his Father, to whom belong glory and power forever and ever. Amen.
Look! He is coming on the clouds of heaven, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over him.
“I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end,” says the Lord God, the one who is, who was, and who is coming, the Almighty.

I, John, your brother and fellow participant in the suffering, the kingdom, and the endurance of our Lord Jesus Christ, was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard a voice behind me like a trumpet,
saying, “Write in a book the things you see and the things you will see, and send them to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
I turned to see the voice of the one speaking with me. When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
and among the lampstands was someone like a son of man, wearing a robe and with a golden belt tied around his chest.
His head and his hair were white like white wool and like snow, and his eyes were like a flame of fire.
His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of many waters.
There were seven stars in his right hand, and a sword sharp on both sides came out of his mouth. His face was like the sun shining in its strength.
When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Do not be afraid. I am the first and the last,
the living one. I died, and look, I am alive forever and ever, and I hold the keys of death and Hades.
So write down the things you have seen, the things that are, and the things that will happen after these.

The mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the seven angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
Write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: These are the words of the Lord, who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands:
I know your deeds, your hard work, and your endurance, and that you cannot tolerate evil people. You tested those who say, ‘We are apostles,’ but are not, and you found them to be liars.
You have endurance, and you have borne hardship because of my name and have not grown weary.
But I have a few things against you, because you have abandoned your first love.
So remember where you have fallen from, repent, and do the deeds you did at first. Otherwise, I am coming to you and will move your lampstand from its place if you do not repent.
But you have this in your favor: You hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
Let anyone who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the middle of the paradise of my God.
Write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and came to life:
I know your suffering and your poverty—but you are rich—and the slander of those who say, “We are Jews,” but are not. Rather, they are the synagogue of Satan.

Do not be afraid of anything you are about to suffer. Look, the devil will throw some of you into prison so that you may be tested, and you will suffer for ten days. Be faithful even to the point of death, and I will give you the crown of life.
Let anyone who has an ear to hear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
Write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: These are the words of the one who has the sharp, two-edged sword:

I know where you live, where Satan’s throne is. You have held firmly to my name and have not denied faith in me. You stood firm in the days when my faithful witness was killed among you, where Satan’s throne resides.

But I have a few things against you: you have some people who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the children of Israel, leading them to eat food sacrificed to idols and to practice sexual immorality.
You are the same: you too have some people who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
Repent, then. Otherwise, I will come to you quickly and fight against you with the sword of my mouth.

Let anyone who has an ear to hear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To whoever overcomes, I will give some of the hidden manna to eat. I will also give him a white stone with a new name written on it, which no one knows except the one who receives it.
Write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a flame of fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze:
I know your deeds, your love, your faith, your service, and your endurance, and your later deeds are greater than your earlier ones.
But I have this against you: you have allowed your wife Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet, to teach and mislead my servants into practicing sexual immorality and eating food sacrificed to idols.
But I gave her time to repent of her sexual immorality.
Look, I will throw her into sickness, and those who commit adultery with her into great suffering, unless she repents of her deeds.
I will put her other children to death, and all the churches will know that I am the one who searches minds and hearts. And I will give each of you according to your deeds.
But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching and have not learned what they call Satan’s secrets: I will place no other burden on you.
Only hold firmly to what you have until I come.
To whoever overcomes and keeps doing my deeds to the end, I will give authority over all the nations.
He will shepherd them with an iron rod and shatter them, just as a potter’s vessels are broken and shattered.
Just as I myself received this authority from my Father, I will also give him the morning star.
Let anyone who has an ear to hear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

Write to the angel of the church in Sardis: These are the words of the one who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars: I know your deeds. You have a reputation for being alive, but you are dead.
Be watchful and strengthen what remains, which was about to die, for I have not found your deeds complete before my God.
Remember, then, how you received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not stay watchful, I will come upon you like a thief, and you will not know how I am coming upon you.
But you have a few people in Sardis who have not stained their clothes. They will walk with me in white garments, because they are worthy.
I will likewise clothe the one who overcomes in white garments. I will not erase his name from the book of life, and I will acknowledge his name before my Father and before his angels.
Let anyone who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
Write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: These are the words of the Holy One, the True One, who has the key of David. When he opens, no one can shut; when he shuts, no one can open.
I know your deeds. Look, I have placed before you an open door that no one will be able to shut, because your strength is small, and you have kept my word and have not denied my name.

Look, I have given some from the synagogue of Satan, those who say, ‘We are Jews,’ but are not, and are lying. Look, I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and you will know that I have loved you.
Because you have kept the word of my endurance, I too will keep you from the hour of testing that is coming upon the whole inhabited world to test those who live on the earth.
I am coming quickly. Hold on to what you have, so that no one falls away.

I will make the one who overcomes a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will never go out again. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down from heaven from my God, and my new name.
Let anyone who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
Write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the first of God's creation.
I know your deeds: you are neither cold nor hot. It would be better if you were cold or hot.
Because you are lukewarm water, neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
For you say, ‘I am rich, and I have become wealthy, and I need nothing,’ but you do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked.

I advise you to buy from me gold refined in fire so that you may become rich, and white clothes to put on so that the shame of your nakedness will not be exposed, and medicine to apply to your eyes so that you may see.
For I rebuke and discipline those I love. So be earnest and repent.
Look, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.
I will grant the one who overcomes a seat beside me on my throne, just as I too overcame and sat beside my Father on his throne.
Let anyone who has an ear hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
After these things, I saw an open door in heaven. The first voice I had heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, said, ‘Come up here, and I will show you what will happen after these things.’
Immediately I was in the Spirit, and look, a throne stood in heaven, with someone sitting on the throne.
The one sitting on the throne looked like jasper and carnelian stones. A light surrounded his throne, looking like carnelian.
Around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and elders sat on the twenty-four thrones, dressed in white clothes, with gold crowns on their heads.
Flashes of lightning, voices, and peals of thunder came from the throne. Seven fiery lamps burned before the throne; these are the seven spirits of God.
Before the throne was a sea of glass, like crystal. In the midst of the throne and around it were four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind.
The first living creature was like a lion, the second living creature was like a calf, the third living creature had a human face, and the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.

Each of the four living creatures had six wings extending from their fingers. They were full of eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stopped saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, the one who is, and the one who was, and those who are coming.”
And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the one sitting on the throne, who lives forever,
the twenty-four elders fall down before the one sitting on the throne and worship the one who lives forever and ever. They throw their crowns before the one sitting on the throne, saying,
“You are worthy, Lord our God, to receive glory, honor, and power, because you created everything, and by your will they exist and were created.”
And I saw a scroll in the right hand of the one sitting on the throne, written on the front and back and sealed with seven seals.
And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming five times in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and undo its seals?”
And no one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look at it.
But I wept bitterly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look at it.
One of the elders said to me, “Do not weep. Look! The Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals.”

And I saw a Lamb standing in the midst of the throne and the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders. It had been slaughtered and had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out over the whole earth.
And he came and took the scroll from the right hand of the one sitting on the throne.
And when he took it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each had a harp, along with golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the holy ones.

And they sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the scroll and open its seals, because you were slaughtered, and with your blood you bought people for our God from every tribe, language, people, and nation.
You made us a kingdom and priests for our God, and they will reign on the earth.”
I looked and heard a voice like that of many angels around the throne, the elders, and the living creatures. They numbered tens of thousands upon tens of thousands and thousands upon thousands,
saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was slaughtered is worthy to receive greatness, wealth, wisdom, might, honor, glory, and blessing!”

And I heard every creature in heaven, on earth, and under the earth, and the sea and everything in them, saying, “To the one sitting on the throne and to the Lamb belong blessing, honor, glory, and might forever and ever!”
And the four living creatures were saying, “Amen!” And the elders fell down and worshiped.
And I watched when the Lamb opened one of the seals. I heard one of the four living creatures saying in a voice like thunder, “Come!”
I looked, and there was a white horse. Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown. He went out conquering, and he conquered.
When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
And a fiery red horse came out. Its rider was given permission to take peace away from the earth so that people would kill one another, and he was given a large sword.
When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come!” And there was a black horse, and its rider had a pair of scales in his hand.
I heard a voice from among the four living creatures saying, “A measure of wheat for a stater, and three measures of barley for a stater. But do not harm the oil and the wine.”
When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, “Come!”

And there was a pale horse. Its rider was named Death, and Hades followed him. He was given authority over a quarter of the earth, to kill people with the sword, with famine, with death, and with the wild beasts of the earth.
When he opened the fifth seal, I saw beneath the altar the souls of the people who had been killed because of God's word and the testimony they held.
They cried out in a loud voice, saying, “How long, Lord, holy and true, will you refrain from judging and avenging our blood on those who live on the earth?”

Each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to rest a little longer, until their other brothers, their fellow servants who were also to be killed as they had been, were complete in number.
I watched when he opened the sixth seal. A great earthquake occurred, the sun became black like sackcloth, and the moon became blood.
The stars of heaven fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when a strong wind shakes it.
The sky rolled up like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and every island was moved from its place.
The kings of the earth, the great men, the military commanders, the rich, the powerful, and every slave and free person hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
They said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the one seated on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb,
for the great day of his wrath has come, and who can stand?”
After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth so that no wind would blow on the earth, on the sea, or on any tree.
I saw another angel coming from where the sun rises, holding the seal of the living God. He cried out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given authority to harm the earth and the sea,
saying, “Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.”
I heard the number of those who had been sealed: one hundred and forty-four thousand from every tribe of the children of Israel.
From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand;
from the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand;
from the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand;
from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand were sealed.

After this I looked, and there was a vast crowd that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, and language. They stood before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
They were shouting loudly, saying, “Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
All the angels stood around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures. They fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might belong to our God forever and ever. Amen!”
One of the elders spoke to me, saying, “Who are these people dressed in these white robes, and where did they come from?”
I said to him, “Lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are the ones coming out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes and cleansed them in the blood of the Lamb.
For this reason they are before the throne of God, serving him day and night in his temple, and the one seated on his throne will shelter them.
They will no longer hunger or thirst, and neither the sun nor any scorching heat will fall upon them.
For the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne will walk with them and shepherd them, and he will lead them to springs of living water, and God will wipe every tear from their eyes.
When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
And I saw the seven angels standing before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
And another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a golden censer. He was given a great deal of incense to offer with the prayers of all the holy ones on the golden altar before the throne.
And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the holy ones, rose from the angel’s hand before God.
And the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it onto the earth. There were thunderclaps, voices, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
And the seven angels holding the seven trumpets prepared themselves to blow them.
The first angel blew his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood. It was thrown onto the earth, and a third of the earth was burned up.
The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood.
And a third of the creatures in the sea that had life in them died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch. It came down on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The name of that star is Wormwood. And a third of the waters became bitter, and many people died from the waters because they had become bitter.

The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, along with a third of the moon and a third of the stars, so that a third of them would become dark and the day would not shine for a third of its duration, and likewise the night.

I saw and heard an eagle flying in the middle of the sky, saying in a loud voice, “Woe three times! Woe to those who live on the earth because of the remaining sounds of the angels who are about to blow their trumpets!”
The fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven onto the earth. It was given the key to the shaft of the abyss.
And when it opened the shaft of the abyss, smoke rose from the shaft like smoke from a great furnace. The sun and the air became dark because of the smoke from the shaft.
And locusts came down onto the earth, and they were given power like the power that the scorpions of the earth have.
They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any tree, but only the people who did not have God’s seal on their foreheads.
And they were not allowed to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment caused by scorpions when they sting a person.
In those days people will seek death but will not find it. They will long to die, and death will flee and leave them behind.
The locusts looked like horses prepared for war, as though there were golden crowns on their heads, and their faces were like human faces.
They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.
They wore breastplates like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots and many horses rushing into battle.
They had tails like those of scorpions, and stingers in their tails. Their power was to hurt people for five months.
They have as their king the angel of the abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek, “the Destroyer.”
Look, one woe has passed. Look, two more woes are coming.
After this, the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar before God,
saying to the sixth angel, who held the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
And the four angels were released. They had been prepared for the hour, the day, the month, and the year, to kill a third of humanity.
The number of the mounted troops was two hundred million. I heard their number.

And this is how I saw the appearance of the horses and their riders: they wore breastplates the color of fire, dark blue, and sulfur. The horses' heads were like lions' heads, and fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of their mouths.
A third of humanity died from these three plagues: the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur coming out of their mouths.
For the power of the horses is in their mouths and their tails. Their tails are like snakes and have heads, and with them they inflict harm.

But the rest of humanity, who had not died from the plagues, still did not repent of the works of their hands and stop worshiping the demons of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
Nor did they repent of their murders, their sorcery, or their sexual immorality.
I saw another powerful angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with light above his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet were like pillars of fire.
He had an open scroll in his hand. He placed his right foot in the sea and his left foot on the shore.
He cried out with a loud voice, like a roaring lion. When he cried out, the seven thunders spoke with their voices.

And when the seven thunders spoke with their voices, I was about to write what the seven thunders had said. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the thunders have said, and do not write it down.”
And the angel whom I had seen standing on the sea and the earth raised his right hand toward heaven
and swore by the one who lives forever and ever, amen, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more time.
But in the days when the seventh angel sounds his trumpet, when he is about to blow it, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as he announced the good news to his servants and the prophets.”
And the voice that I had heard speaking to me from heaven said to me again, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and the shore.”
I went to the angel and said to him, “Give me the scroll.” He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will be bitter in your stomach, but in your mouth it will be sweet like honey.”
I took the scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it. It was sweet like honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, it became bitter in my stomach.
He said to me, “You must prophesy again about peoples, nations, languages, and many kings.”
And I was given a reed like a rod, with these words: “Get up and measure the temple of God, the altar, and those who worship in it.
But leave out the courtyard outside the temple and do not measure it, because it has been given to the nations. They will trample the holy city for forty-two months.
And I will grant this to my two witnesses: they will prophesy for twelve hundred and sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”
These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands standing before the Lord of the earth.
If anyone wants to harm them, fire comes out of their mouth and consumes their enemies. If anyone wants to harm them, this is how that person will be killed.

They have authority to shut the sky so that no rain falls throughout the days of their prophecy. They also have authority to turn the water into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
When they have completed their testimony, the beast that comes up from the abyss will wage war against them, defeat them, and kill them.
And their bodies will lie in the streets of the great city spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord was also crucified.
And nations from among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations will look at their corpses for three and a half days, and they will not allow anyone to bury their bodies in tombs.
And those who live on the earth will rejoice over them and celebrate and send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who live on the earth.
But after three and a half days, a spirit of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.
I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” And they went up to heaven in a cloud while their enemies watched them.
On that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people died in the earthquake, and the rest were afraid and gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second woe has passed. Look, the third woe is coming quickly.
The seventh angel blew his trumpet, and loud voices sounded in heaven, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of the Lord and his Christ, and he will reign forever and ever.”
And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
saying, “We thank you, Lord God Almighty, who is and who was, because you have taken up your great power and have begun to reign.

The nations became angry, and your wrath has come, along with the time to judge the living and the dead, to give the reward to your servants and the prophets and your holy ones and those who fear your name, both small and great, and to destroy those who destroyed the earth.”
And God's temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord's covenant appeared in the temple. There were flashes of lightning, voices, thunder, earthquakes, and a great hailstorm.
And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet and twelve stars as a crown on her head.
And she was pregnant and in labor, crying out as she suffered the pains of giving birth.
A sign appeared in heaven, and look, there was a great red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on its heads.

And its tail swept away a third of the stars of heaven and threw them down onto the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth to her child, it could devour him.
And she gave birth to a son, who will shepherd all the nations with an iron rod. And her child was snatched away to God and to his throne.
But the woman fled into the wilderness, to a place prepared for her by God, so that they could feed her there for one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
And war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and its angels fought back.
But they could not prevail, nor did they find their place in heaven.
The great dragon was thrown down—the ancient serpent called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world. He was thrown down onto the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

I heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Now salvation and power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of his Christ have come, because the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, the one who accuses them before God day and night.
And he overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb and because of the word of their testimony. They did not love their lives even to the point of death.
Therefore rejoice, heavens and those who live in them! Woe to the earth and the sea, because the Devil has come down to you with great anger, knowing that he has only a little time left.”
When the dragon saw that he had been thrown down onto the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the son.
And the woman was given two eagle’s wings so that she could fly away into the wilderness, to her place, where she would be cared for for a time, times, and half a time, away from the serpent.
And the serpent hurled water from its mouth like a river after the woman, so that it would make her drown.
And the earth helped the woman. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon was hurling from its mouth.
The dragon became angry with the woman and went away to wage war against the rest of her offspring, those who keep God’s commandments and the testimony of Jesus.
And I stood on the sand of the sea.
I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its heads and a blasphemous name written on its heads.
And the beast I saw resembled a leopard. Its feet were like those of a bear, and its mouth was like a lion’s mouth. And the dragon gave it its power, its throne, and great authority.
And one of its heads looked as though it had been wounded to death, but its fatal wound was healed. The whole earth followed the beast in amazement.
And they worshiped the dragon because it had given authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like it, and who is able to fight against it?”
It was given a mouth that spoke boastful words and blasphemies, and it was permitted to wage war for forty-two months.
It opened its mouth to blaspheme God’s name, his dwelling, and those who live in heaven.
And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation.
And everyone living on the earth will worship him, those whose names have not been written in the book of life of the Lamb who was slaughtered from the foundation of the world.
Anyone who has an ear should listen.
Whoever takes people captive will be taken into captivity. Whoever kills with a sword will be killed with the sword. This calls for the endurance and faith of the holy ones.
I saw another beast coming up out of the sea. It had two horns like a lamb, and it spoke like the dragon.
It exercises the authority of the first beast in its presence, and it made the earth and those who live on it worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.
And it will perform great signs, even making fire come from heaven onto the earth in front of people.

It was deceiving those who live on the earth through the signs it had been allowed to perform in the beast’s presence, telling those who live on the earth, “Make an image of the beast that had the sword wound and lived.”
And it was allowed to give breath to the image of the beast so that the image of the beast could speak. And it will arrange for those who will not worship the beast to be killed.
And it will require everyone, small and great, rich and poor, free and enslaved, to be given marks on their right hand or on their forehead,
so that no one can buy or sell except someone who has the beast’s mark or its name.
This calls for wisdom. Let anyone who has understanding calculate the number of the beast’s name, for it is a human number. It is six hundred sixty-six, 666.
I looked, and there was a lamb standing on Mount Zion, with 144,000 beside it, having its name and its Father’s name written on their foreheads.
And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and like the sound of great peals of thunder. The sound I heard was like harpists playing their harps.
And they sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could understand the song except the 144,000 who had been purchased from the earth.

These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These are the ones who were purchased from among humanity as firstfruits for God and the Lamb.
And no lie was found in their mouths, for they are without sin.
I saw an angel flying in midheaven, holding an everlasting gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
He said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship the one who made heaven and earth, the sea, and the springs of water.”
Another angel, a second, followed him, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the Great! And all the nations have fallen through the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”
Another angel, a third, followed them, saying in a loud voice, “Whoever worships the beast or its image and receives its markings on his forehead or on his hand,

he too will drink the wine of God's wrath, which is poured undiluted into the cup of his anger. And they will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
And the smoke of their torment will rise forever and ever. Those who worship the beast and its image, and whoever receives the mark of its name, will have no rest day or night.”
Here is the place for the endurance of the saints, those who keep God's commandments and faith in Jesus.
I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write: Blessed are those who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” said the Spirit, “so that they may rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.”
I looked, and there was a white cloud. Sitting on the cloud was someone like a son of man, with a golden crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

And another angel came out of the temple, crying out in a loud voice to the one sitting on the cloud, “Send out your sickle and reap, because the hour for reaping has come, because the earth's harvest has dried.”
And the one sitting on the cloud cast his sickle down upon the earth.
Another angel came out of the temple that is in the midst, holding a sharp sickle.

Another angel came out from the altar, having authority over fire. He called in a loud voice to the one holding the sharp sickle, saying, “Send out your sickle and gather the clusters of the earth's grapevine, because its grapes are ripe.”
And the angel cast his sickle onto the earth and gathered the earth's grapevine, and [?] into the great winepress of God's wrath.
The winepress was trampled outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress, reaching as high as the horses' bridles for sixteen hundred stadia.
I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels holding seven final plagues, because through them God's wrath was brought to completion.
I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire. Those who overcome the beast, its image, and the number of its name were standing on a sea of glass, holding harps of God.

They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Your deeds and your ways are righteous and true, [?] of the ages.
Who will not fear you, Lord, and give glory to your name? For you alone are holy and righteous. All the nations will come and worship before you, because your righteous acts have been revealed.”
After these things, the temple of the tent of testimony in heaven was opened.
And the seven angels holding the seven plagues came out of the temple, wearing white, clean garments, with golden sashes fastened around their chests.
And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls, filled with the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to the angels, “Pour out the bowls of God's wrath.”
The first went and poured out the bowl onto the earth, and a foul, terrible sore appeared on those who had the mark of the beast and those who worshiped its image.
The second poured out his bowl onto the sea, and it became blood like that of the dead, and every living creature in the sea died.
The third poured out his bowl onto the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.
I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are just, the one who is and who was, the Holy One, because you have judged these things.
For they poured out the blood of the prophets, and you gave them blood to drink, because they deserve it.”
I heard the altar saying, “Lord God Almighty, your judgments are true and just.”
The fourth angel poured out his bowl onto the sun, and it was allowed to scorch people with fire.
And people were scorched by intense heat, and they blasphemed the name of God, who has authority over all these plagues, and they did not repent and give him glory.
The fifth poured out his bowl onto the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became dark, and they were gnawing their tongues because of the pain.
And they were blaspheming the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and they did not repent of their deeds.
The sixth poured out his bowl onto the great river Euphrates, and its water dried up so that the way would be prepared for the kings from the east.
I saw three unclean spirits like frogs coming out of the mouth of the dragon, from the beast, and from the mouth of the false prophet.
For they are demonic spirits performing signs to bring out the kings of the whole inhabited world and gather them for the battle of the great day of God Almighty.
Look, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and guards his clothes, so that he does not walk naked and people see his shame.
And he gathered them for the battle that is called Armageddon in Hebrew.
The seventh poured out his bowl onto the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple, from the throne, saying, “It has happened.”
There were flashes of lightning, voices, thunder, and a great earthquake, unlike any that had occurred since human beings were born on the earth—an earthquake so great and so powerful.
The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And Babylon the Great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of his furious wrath.
And no island or mountain could be found.
Great hailstones, weighing about a talent, rained down from heaven onto people, and the people blasphemed God because of the plague of hail, for its plague was extremely severe.
One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come, and I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those who live on the earth became drunk with the wine of her sexual immorality.”
He carried me away in the Spirit into the wilderness, and I saw a woman seated on a scarlet beast, full of blasphemous names, with seven heads and ten horns.

And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, gold, precious stones, and pearls. She had a golden cup in her hand, full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality and those of the earth.
A mysterious name was written on her forehead: “Babylon the Great, the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.”
And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the holy ones and the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. When I saw her, I was amazed.
The angel said to me, “Why are you amazed? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has seven heads and ten horns.

The beast you saw once existed and does not exist, and it is coming up from the abyss and going to destruction. Those who live on the earth, whose names have not been written in the book of life since the foundation of the world, will be amazed when they see the beast, because it once existed, does not exist, and will exist.
Here is the place for a mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits, and they are seven kings.
Five have fallen, one exists, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he will remain for a little while.
And the beast that once existed and now does not exist is itself the eighth, one of the seven, and it is going to destruction.
And the ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received kingship, but they will receive authority from the beast.
These will be of one mind and will give their power and authority to the beast.
These will fight against the Lamb, and the Lamb will defeat them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings. Those with him are the called, the chosen, and the faithful.”
And he said to me, “The waters, these rivers you saw on which the prostitute sits, are peoples, tribes, and languages.
And the ten horns you saw and the beast will hate the prostitute. They will make her desolate and leave her naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
For God has put it into their hearts to carry out his will, to have one purpose, and to give their kingdom to the beast until the words of God are fulfilled.
And the woman you saw is the great city in which is the wealth of the kings of the earth.”
After these things I saw another angel coming from heaven, having great authority, and he shone with his glory.

He cried out in a loud voice, “Babylon the Great has fallen! She has become a dwelling place for demons and every unclean spirit, and a dwelling place for every beast and every bird and unclean, detestable things.

For all the nations have fallen because of the wine of the fury of her sexual immorality. The kings of the earth have committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have become rich through the power of her luxurious living.”
And I heard another voice from heaven saying, “My people, come out of her, so that you do not share in her sins and do not receive any of her plagues.
For her sins have risen up to heaven, and God has remembered her acts of injustice.
Repay her according to what she has done, and repay her twice over for her deeds. In the cup in which she mixed a drink, mix twice as much for her.
For the boasting and luxury in which she lived, give her a corresponding amount of torment and grief, because she says in her heart, ‘I will not sit as a widow, nor will I ever see grief.’
Therefore all her plagues will come in a single day: death, mourning, and famine. And she will be burned with fire, because the Lord God who judges her is mighty.
And the kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke of her burning.
They will stand far away because of their fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe to the great city, Babylon, the mighty city! For in a single hour her judgment has come.’
The merchants of the earth will weep and grieve over her, because there is no longer anyone [?] their merchandise:

merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, fragrant wood, every kind of ivory article, and every kind of article made of costly wood, bronze, iron, and marble.
and cinnamon, amomum, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, oil, fine flour, cattle, sheep, horses, mules, camels, chariots, and slaves.
And the fruit your soul desired has gone away, and your great, abundant luxuries have perished, and they will not find them.
The merchants who became rich through her will stand far away because they fear her torment, weeping and mourning,
saying, “Woe, woe to the great city, clothed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and in gold, precious stones, and pearls,
because in a single hour this great wealth has been destroyed!” And every ship’s captain, those who sail on the rivers, the sailors, and those who work at sea stood far away.
They cried out as they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, “Who is like this great city, through which all the rulers became rich?”

And they threw dust on their heads, crying out, weeping, and mourning, saying, “Woe, woe to the great city, through whose wealth those who own ships at sea became rich, because in a single hour she has become desolate!”
Rejoice over her, heaven, and you holy ones, apostles, and prophets, because God has judged your case against her.
And a mighty angel lifted a large stone, like a millstone, and threw it into the sea, saying, “This is how Babylon, the great city, will be thrown down violently, and she will not be found.
And harpists, musicians, singers, and trumpets will no longer be heard in her. No craftspeople of any craft will be found in you from now on, and the sound of a mill will no longer be heard in you.

Nor will the voice of a bridegroom and bride be heard, nor will a lamp be lit in you from now on. The great ones of the earth were merchants, because through your sorcery all the nations were led astray.”
And in her was found the blood of the prophets, of the holy ones, and of everyone who had been killed on the earth.
After these things I heard a loud voice, like a vast crowd in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God,
because your judgments are true and just, because you have judged the prostitute who corrupted the earth through her prostitution, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hands.”
And they said a second time, “Hallelujah!” And her smoke rises forever and ever.
And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
And voices came from the throne, saying, “Praise God, all his servants who fear him, small and great!”
And I heard a voice like a great crowd, like the roar of many lions, and like the sound of many mighty thunderclaps, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns forever and ever!
Let us rejoice and be glad and give him glory, because the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.”
And she was allowed to clothe herself in white, fine, pure linen, for the fine linen is the righteous deeds of the holy ones.
And he said to me, “Write: Blessed are those who have been invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” He said to me, “These words I have spoken are true, and they belong to God.”

And I fell down before his feet to worship him. And he said to me, “Do not! Be careful, for I am your fellow servant and the fellow servant of your brothers who have the testimony of Jesus Christ. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
I saw heaven open, and there was a white horse. Its rider is called Faithful and True. He will judge and wage war with justice.
His eyes were like a flame of fire, and there were many crowns on his head. He had a name written that no one knows except himself.
He was clothed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name was called the Word of God.
And his armies in heaven were following him, riding white horses and clothed in white, clean linen.

And a sharp sword was coming out of his mouth, so that with it he would strike all the nations. And he himself will shepherd them with an iron rod, and he himself will tread the winepress of the fury of the anger of God Almighty.
A name is written on his robe and his thigh: “The King of kings and the Lord of lords.”
And I saw another angel standing on the sun, crying out with a loud voice and saying to the birds flying in midair, “Come, gather together for the great feast of God.”
So that you may eat the flesh of kings, commanders, mighty men, horses and their riders, slaves and free people, small and great.
And I saw the beast, its kings, and its army gathered to wage war against the one riding the white horse and against his army.

And he seized the beast and those with it, and the false prophet who was with it, and the one who had performed the signs in its presence, by which he had deceived those who received the beast’s mark and those who worshiped its image. The two of them were thrown alive into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.
And the rest died by the sword of the one riding his horse, the sword that came out of his mouth. And all the birds were filled with their flesh.
I saw an angel coming from heaven, holding the keys to the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil, Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

He threw him down into the abyss, shut it over him, and sealed it over him so that he would no longer deceive the nations until the thousand years were completed. After this, he will be released for another short time.

After this I saw thrones, and people sat on them and were given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been killed because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and who had not received its mark on their forehead or on their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
But the rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

Blessed and holy is the one who has a share in the first resurrection, because the second death has no authority over such a person. Instead, they will be priests of God and his Christ, and they will reign with him for the thousand years.
But when the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his bonds.
And he will go out to deceive the inhabited world and gather Gog and Magog from the four corners of the earth for war. They are like the sand of the sea.
And they came up across the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the holy ones and the beloved city. And a fire came from heaven, from God, and consumed them.

But the devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, the place where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. And they will be tormented night and day and will have no rest forever.
I saw a great white throne and the one sitting on it. The earth and heaven fled from his presence, and no place was found for them.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. Books were opened, and another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to their deeds, from what was written in the books.
The sea gave up the dead who were in it, and the abyss and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. And each one was judged according to their deeds.
And the abyss and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, which is the lake of fire.
And anyone who was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
And I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea no longer existed.
And I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down from heaven, from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
I heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Look, God’s dwelling is with human beings. He will live with them, and they will be his people, and the Lord himself will be their God.”
And he will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death, mourning, crying, or suffering from now on, because the former things have passed away.
And the one seated on the throne said, “Look, I will make everything new.” And he said to me, “Write, because these words that I have spoken are trustworthy and true.”
He said to me, “I have become Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give freely to whoever is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.”
“Whoever overcomes will inherit these things, and I will be his God, and he will be my son.”

“But as for the cowardly, the unbelieving, the detestable, murderers, the sexually immoral, sorcerers, idol worshipers, and all liars, their share will be in the lake burning with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”
And another of the seven angels who had the seven bowls filled with the final plagues came and spoke to me, saying, “Come, let me show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
And he took me in the Spirit onto a great, high mountain and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.
It had the glory of God. Its light was like a precious gemstone, like a jasper stone resembling crystal.
It had a high wall and twelve gates, with twelve angels at the gates. Names were written on it corresponding to the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
Three gates faced east, three gates faced north, three faced west, and three faced south.
On the twelve foundations of the city's wall were written the names of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
And the one speaking to me held a golden measuring rod to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
And the city was square, its length equal to its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve hundred stadia in length. Its width and its height were equal to one another.
And he measured its wall: one hundred forty-four cubits by a human measure, which was also an angel’s measure.
Its wall was built of jasper, and the city was built of fine gold resembling pure glass.
The foundations of the city’s wall were made with every kind of precious gemstone. The first foundation resembled jasper, the second was sapphire, the third chalcedony, and the fourth emerald.
The fifth was sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, each gate made from a single pearl. The city’s street was pure gold, like clear glass.
But I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God and the Lamb are its temple.
And the city had no need of the sun or the moon to shine upon it, for God's glory illuminates it, and the Lamb is its lamp.
And the nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it.
And its gates will not be shut by day or by night, for there will be no night there.
They will bring in the glory and honor of the nations.
And no one who is defiled will enter it, nor those who do detestable things or tell lies, but only those written in the Lamb’s book.
He showed me a river of living water, bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and the Lamb.
In the middle of the city’s street, on either side of the river, was a tree of life producing twelve crops of fruit, giving its fruit each month. Its leaves were for the healing of the nations.
And there will be nothing detestable from now on. The throne of God and the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.
They will see his face, and his name will be written on their foreheads.
There will no longer be night, and they will no longer need the light of lamps or the light of the sun, because the Lord God will shine on them. And they will reign forever and ever.
He said to me, “These words are reliable and true. And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent me, his angel, to show his servants what will happen soon.”
Look, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of this prophecy in this book.
I too, John, am the one who hears and sees these things. When I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who was showing me these things.
And he said to me, “Do not do that! I am your fellow servant, along with your brothers, the prophets, and those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”
And he said to me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.”

Let the one who acts unjustly continue to act unjustly, and let the one who is filthy continue to become filthy. Let the righteous person continue to do what is right, and let the holy person continue to purify himself.
Look, I am coming soon, and my reward is with me, to give to each person according to their deeds.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
Blessed are those who have washed their robes, so that they will have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city through the gates.
But their dogs will be thrown out, along with the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idol worshipers, and everyone who practices and loves falsehood.
I, Jesus, sent my angel to testify to you about these things in the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, and the bright morning star.
And the Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” Let the one who is thirsty come, and let anyone who wishes take the water of life freely.
I myself testify to everyone who hears the words of this prophecy in this book: if anyone adds to it, God will add to that person the plagues written in this book.
And if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away that person’s share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book.
The one who bears witness said, “These things happen. I am coming soon.” Come, Lord Jesus!
The grace of our Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen. The Revelation of John.
